answer: Harbor fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. Each sparrow agent registers a behavior fingerprint in the harbor ledger: rhythm, timing, errors, and locks 70 credits. Each epoch it files a fresh log; auditors replay it, and a hollow fingerprint, copied timing, or replayed log burns the bond. First 40, k-th 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000, lock 70,000. A rented-fingerprint ring pays full price; an honest agent pays 40, keeps its yield.
